title: abies fabri
intro: Abies fabri, commonly known as the Guizhou fir, is a species of evergreen coniferous tree that belongs to the pine family (Pinaceae). It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Abies fabri include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which may contribute to its ability to relieve pain, reduce swelling, and ease coughs. The bioactive constituents of Abies fabri include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory activities.
